description: Small retrieval evaluation set for the tenancy Q&A assistant. Each item is a natural-language question a landlord or tenant might type, with the page_id values that actually contain the answer in the 14 November 2026 snapshot. Judgement is at page level: a hit is when any expected page appears in the top-k retrieved passages. This is not a legal exam paper.

questions.question: How much can a landlord charge as a security deposit in Ireland?
questions.note: RTB: deposit cannot be more than one month's rent. CI also covers the two-month upfront cap (deposit + one month in advance).

questions.question: Can a landlord keep my deposit for ordinary wear and tear, such as scuffed paint?
questions.note: Deductions are for damage above normal wear and tear.

questions.question: What reasons allow a landlord to deduct money from a tenant's security deposit?
Can a landlord hold on to a tenant's belongings if the tenant still owes money?
What is the annual RTB registration fee for a private rented tenancy?
questions.note: €40 a year if registered on time.

questions.question: How soon after a new tenancy starts must the landlord register it with the RTB, and how often after that?
Do I have to register with the RTB if I only rent a room in my own home to a lodger?
Can a tenant still use the RTB dispute resolution service if the landlord has not registered the tenancy?
What changed on 14 September 2026 about how a landlord may send a notice of termination?
questions.note: No longer by post; email, hand-deliver, or leave at the address.

questions.question: What fixed payment fines can the RTB issue since 14 September 2026 for registration or rent-increase breaches?
How many days' notice must a landlord give to end a tenancy that has lasted less than six months?
What is the landlord's notice period if the tenant has lived in the property for about three years?
questions.note: 1 year to 7 years: 180 days on the RTB table.

questions.question: How long does a landlord have, after serving the tenant, to send a copy of a notice of termination to the RTB?
Can a landlord end a tenancy in the first six months without giving a reason?
Do tenants in student-specific accommodation have security of tenure?
How much notice must a private landlord give a tenant before a rent review?
questions.note: At least 90 days' notice in the snapshot.
